questions.question: What does the son scream in his nightmare?
answers: "A crashed plane! It's burning! The little man can't get out!"
questions.explanation: He repeats the same words every night.

questions.question: How does the son play with the planes?
answers: He crashes them — banging one against another
questions.explanation: He crashes the toys until the wings fall off.

questions.question: Which three names does the son give?
questions.explanation: He points at three crashed planes and gives those names.

questions.question: What surnames of pilots does Mark find in the archive?
questions.explanation: The list of the fallen: Piller, Devlin, Conner.

questions.question: What does the son say in the morning after the last nightmare about Leon?
answers: "Yes, Dad. Everyone. They're there." — and points at the sky
That he is afraid of planes
questions.explanation: He says everyone came back — they're there, pointing at the sky.
